subject: Consolidated group demo for BrightLayer — slot options and agenda
messages:
From: Emma Patel <emma@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated group demo request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the intro — we discussed this internally and would like to schedule a single walkthrough that pulls in three product leads across our stack (ML infra, Platform Integrations, and Security). Ideally we'd keep this under 60 minutes, with 30 minutes of demo and 30 minutes for Q&A.

Who from Redwood should join? Our tentative attendee list: me (Emma), Raj Singh (Head of Platform), and our Sr Security PM (TBD). We prefer an evening (PST) slot the week of Apr 3–7. Can you propose 2–3 times and a short agenda?

Also flagging that security will want to collect a short list of evidence items ahead of time (data residency, audit logs retention, SOC 2 scope).

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Patel
Senior Product Manager
BrightLayer
emma@brightlayer.com

Hi Emma — great to hear. Happy to run the demo.

Proposed 3 slots (all PST):
- Tue Apr 4, 5:00–6:00pm
- Wed Apr 5, 6:30–7:30pm
- Thu Apr 6, 4:00–5:00pm

Suggested agenda (45–60m):
1) 5m quick intros / goals
2) 25–30m targeted product demo (batching, routing, Dedicated vs Hosted options relevant to platform customers)
3) 15–20m security & integration Q&A (Ben to cover common questions)
4) Next steps / mutual action items (Doc + sample configs)

Ben — looping you in for the security/integration portion and to confirm your availability for those times.

If any of those slots won't work, say so and I can open a couple more. I can also attach a short deck if that helps prep the group.

Best,
Marissa
